title: Clinical Inference Engine for Physiological Signal Studies
text: estimates require sequential ignorability, consistency, positivity, treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounder, correctly specified models. indirect effect proof biological mechanism.
code: if (requireNamespace("mediation", quietly = TRUE)) {   data(jobs, package = "mediation")   model_m <- lm(job_seek ~ treat + econ_hard + sex + age, data = jobs)   model_y <- lm(     depress2 ~ treat + job_seek + econ_hard + sex + age,     data = jobs   )   result <- causalMediation(     model_m, model_y,     treat = "treat", mediator = "job_seek",     sims = 1000, seed = 481   )   PhysioCore::resultValue(result)$effects }

title: Clinical Inference Engine for Physiological Signal Studies
text: Time zero every protocol component declared rather inferred. Inspect positivity, balance, censoring, raw-versus-analysis weight diagnostics interpreting contrast. Cox hazard ratios non-collapsible marginal risk ratios.
code: protocol <- targetTrialProtocol(   eligibility = function(data) data$eligible,   treatment_strategies = list(never = 0, always = 1),   assignment = "clone eligible participants",   time_zero = 0,   follow_up = 12,   outcome = "recovery by week 12",   causal_contrast = "always versus never",   analysis_plan = "clone-censor-weight" )  result <- targetTrialEmulate(   longitudinal_data, protocol,   id = "participant", time = "week", treatment = "treated",   outcome = "recovered",   baseline_covariates = c("age", "baseline_score"),   time_varying_covariates = "current_score",   estimand = "per_protocol" ) PhysioCore::resultValue(result)$effects

title: Fit a mixed model for repeated measures (MMRM) — fitMMRM
text: Fits Mallinckrodt MMRM longitudinal randomised trial: fixed effects treatment, categorical time interaction (plus covariates), within-subject covariance repeated time points. Uses mmrm package available - Kenward-Roger Satterthwaite adjusted degrees freedom - falls back nlme::gls otherwise. fallback reproduces mmrm fixed effects unstructured covariance (primary use) approximates homogeneous cs/ar1/toeplitz structures; reports -within (containment) degrees freedom emits message, since Kenward-Roger / Satterthwaite df need mmrm.
